race.description: Book Your Xmas Party Now - Friday 4th December Hcp (55)
race.comment: STRENUOUS (6) goes on top after leading pillar-to-post in style at Bowraville last start. Tougher now but he has now won at the trip and keeps McColm's claim. WATER LAD (4) was well below his best last time but his form prior stacks right up. Gets in well with the 3kg claim and is worth another look. PIERTAGA (11) bounced back sharply at Warwick, charging into second after being bumped at the start. The form around her stacks right up and she gets a key booking in Wiggins. Can play a major role. ZHONGXIN KOALA (7) is fitter second-up after having little luck when held up at Beaudesert. Draws to get back again but can launch late if the pace is genuine.
